response: The prognosis of polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) can be predicted to some extent at disease onset. A higher erythrocyte sedimentation rate (PV) in PMR increases the risk of prolonged steroid therapy and late giant cell arteritis (GCA). Additionally, female sex and particular HLA alleles may also increase the risk of late GCA. Starting patients on more than 15 mg of prednisolone is associated with a prolonged steroid duration. These factors can help guide treatment decisions and predict the likelihood of a prolonged course of steroid therapy. However, it is essential to note that individual patient outcomes may vary, and regular monitoring is necessary to adjust treatment plans accordingly.
